facts.claim: Norwegian Jade (Norwegian Cruise Line): Entered service 2006; 93,558 GT; 2402 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 294 m length; Jewel class.
Norwegian Jade is a cruise ship for Norwegian Cruise Line (NCL), originally built as Pride of Hawaii for their NCL America division.
